is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles gambiae (page 3, 'Methods': 'A total of 362 indoor resting adults and larvae were collected from 13 locations... of the Comoros... Species were determined based on the combination of species diagnostic assays and a divergence island SNP (DIS) genotyping assay.').

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped the East African kdr mutation L1014S (Vgsc L995S) (page 3, 'Results & discussion': 'A. gambiae from Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, had the kdr-East (L1014S) genotype at a frequency of 96%... In contrast, all A. gambiae from the Comoros were homozygous for the susceptible kdr alleles.').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides site-specific sample sizes and genotype counts (+/+, E/+, E/E) and allele frequencies (%E) for 14 sites across the Comoros and Dar es Salaam, Tanzania (total N = 387 mosquitoes genotyped for kdr).

african_field_population.evidence: Indoor resting adults and larvae were field-collected from 14 sites across the Union of the Comoros and Dar es Salaam, Tanzania in February and March 2011 (page 3, 'Methods' and Table 1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research observation article presenting original field collections and SNP genotyping data using Sequenom iPLEX (page 3).

sub_country_location.evidence: Table 1 lists 14 specific collection localities in Comoros (e.g., Assimpao, Boeninidi, Bouni, Moya) and Dar es Salaam in Tanzania, complete with geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Samples were collected within a two-month timeframe: 'between February and March, 2011' (page 3, 'Methods').

duplicate_risk.evidence: Mosquitoes from Dar es Salaam were obtained from Dr. Kija Ngh'abi at Ifakara Health Institute (page 3), but the Comoros collection is an original primary survey.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts, sample numbers, and site coordinates are completely presented in Table 1 of the main manuscript.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the frequency of the Vgsc L995S (L1014S, kdr-East) marker across 14 sites in the Union of the Comoros and one site in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania collected in February-March 2011. While Dar es Salaam showed near fixation of the L1014S resistance allele (98% allele frequency), all 362 An. gambiae tested across the Comoros were homozygous wild-type (+/+).
